recommendation.reason: Reviewed current tensor paths have natural domains, existing real schedulers or legitimate action/primitive boundaries. recommendation.strongest_reason_to_retain: CG/BFS/SSSP show real cross-action feedback; while directly expresses first-false exit and avoids having to find a useful bound or retrofit absorbing state. This is substantive expressivity/readability, not completeness for its own sake.
recommendation.cost_of_removal: Uncapped cross-action local feedback is outside the proposed core; some bounded feedback may require more text or state. Authors must not be forced to invent caps, domains or opaque actions.

supported_claims: No unavoidable pipe-while mechanism was found in the ten reviewed root paths at the stated action granularity; this is supported by source control provenance, not only existing trial syntax.
CG, correct level-synchronous BFS, and the cited SSSP under stated execution contracts exhibit legitimate cross-action feedback and have a real cap or natural finite bounds.
The actual Gamma sampler is thread-local; DMR/MIS outer feedback is host orchestration. Their exclusion does not require enlarging compute to hide a cross-role protocol.
A constructed cross-role rejection-sampling protocol refutes universal natural elimination when almost-sure termination is accepted.

The exact SSSP queue schedule has outer<=V and each inner<=V under explicit execution contracts; the earlier iteration-bound uncertainty is resolved, while CUDA contract realization remains unverified.
unsupported_claims: Every well-defined operator has no need for while.
All 193 old YAML nodes or all 44 candidate operators/compile variants were semantically proved while-free.
Every original trial is source/event equivalent merely because the control language can express its loops.
A cap alone makes a mechanical for/if transformation valid.
Any feedback loop can be renamed as a dynamic worktile generator.
An inactive for tail necessarily slows the GPU or must be emitted literally.
Removing core while proves termination, eliminates asynchronous protocol obligations, or yields a finite static event graph.
The SSSP V/V proof certifies every CUDA execution, fixed 2E capacity on every graph, unchecked signed overflow, or omitted source edges.

execution_contract: Finite static graph, valid source and node IDs, nonnegative integer weights.
Every executed candidate addition, i increment, and curdelta increment is representable.
Complete processing of the fixed edge domain selected by the source for the ready frontier.
Linearizable atomicMin; ordinary distance reads follow monotone decreases; sequential source rereads do not increase.
No observations older than the preceding completed wave barrier; collective count observations agree.
Sufficient queue capacity, completed reservation and payload publication, no lost notifications.
Dedup preserves one representative of every deferred vertex; no external work injection.
Shortest-path correctness for the original graph additionally requires complete coverage of its needed edges; termination applies to the fixed actually scanned graph.
Positive DELTA as required by the source option contract.
sssp.notification_lemma: c_class <= c_atomic <= c_check < d_entry[v]; notification need not mean this atomic succeeded, but implies some decrease of the target in the current wave.
sssp.outer_argument: Dirty sources are contained in initial frontier; subsequent waves keep Dirty within retry plus deferred. Deferred is processed next epoch without waiting for delta. Each epoch achieves at least one Bellman propagation step; V-1 steps plus one stale-notification drain gives V.
sssp.inner_argument: Threshold-clipped labels obey a Bellman propagation invariant for low dirty sources. After V-1 waves low labels settle. Any further retry must imply a low target decrease or a source decrease to/further within the threshold, impossible after settlement; wave V drains retry.

bounded_elimination_audit.tail_cost: Potential description/checking or literal-interpreter cost; source while/break can skip pure stable inactive tails. No GPU speed claim.

boundary_audit.gamma: Actual sampler/RNG/acceptance state is element-local with only final output exposed; no artificial merging of existing cross-role events.
boundary_audit.dmr_mis: Actual feedback repeats host launches. Current pipe cannot redo these submissions merely by adding while; dynamic host orchestration remains a separate scope issue.
boundary_audit.dynamic_for_legal: Real task inputs, outputs, identity, allocation/production interface and termination protocol already explain the work stream. Generated tasks may be valid when the actual scheduler owns that duty.
boundary_audit.dynamic_for_illegal: Post hoc rounds until acceptance/convergence, a domain provider silently running the algorithm, hidden enqueue/ack/termination, or a redesigned scheduler presented as mere syntax elimination.
boundary_audit.encapsulation_rule: Fix the design-level publication/consumption/reuse boundaries before choosing the control form; neither split every instruction nor erase already useful independent interfaces.

scope_statement: Core covers defined ordered input/metadata domains, real scheduled worktile streams, and bounded gates that retain ready conditions, stopping state, action handoffs and original exits. Primitive waits/retries and genuinely local algorithms stay in action contracts. Reasonable cross-action feedback without a suitable finite bound is explicitly outside this proposed core, eligible for reconsideration rather than forced encoding.
minimal_reconsideration_trigger: One actual kernel now targeted for schema whose feedback controls several useful action interfaces and whose natural for/if version would invent a domain/cap, change exits/protocol, or require materially artificial state. Significant bounded-feedback authoring cost also qualifies; no impossibility theorem required.
